resolution.note: adopt --verify names drifted or missing adoption files; --refresh rewrites them; any canary failure rolls back

title: krn adopt --verify reports adoption files that drifted from what adopt writes
body:
Why: operator-shared trending triage 2026-11-14: NVIDIA/auto-ontology publishes with a read-back (re-export and compare, success:true is not proof). `krn adopt` writes the adoption set (hooks, standards, skills, conventions) but nothing proves an adopted repository still holds what adopt wrote; inherited standards drift silently.
Outcome: `krn adopt <path> --verify` also compares every adoption-set file in the repository with what the current `krn adopt` would write (content hash) and reports each drifted or missing file by path; exit non-zero on drift.
Proof: test against a real adopted fixture: an edited hook file and a deleted standards record are each named; an untouched adoption reports clean. npm run fast PASS.
Scope: src/adopt/, test/.
